compareDisposition.rationale: No distinct two-source pairing adds more than this passage and its existing Scripture connections.

observations.body: Hebrews reads Melchizedek, blessing, tithes, oath, and endless life to contrast Levitical succession with Jesus’ permanent priesthood.
observations.label: A different priesthood is argued from Melchizedek

observations.body: The passage presents king-priest, blessing, descent, oath, permanence, intercession, and self-offering as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: king-priest, blessing, descent, oath, permanence, intercession, and self-offering

observations.body: The passage places melchizedek priesthood beside king-priest, blessing, descent, oath, permanence, intercession, and self-offering.
observations.label: melchizedek priesthood

payload.posture: Read Hebrews 7:1–28 as evidence about sacrifice, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: the argument depends on textual features and should not be collapsed into a biography of Melchizedek
payload.title: A different priesthood is argued from Melchizedek
